settings.emailImport.dragDrop.name: Automatically import dropped email files
settings.emailImport.dragDrop.descriptio: When an .eml or .msg file is added to the vault, import it automatically into the same folder without an additional review dialog.
settings.emailImport.attachments.name: Automatically extract email attachments
settings.emailImport.attachments.descrip: For automatic drag-and-drop imports, extract ordinary attachments next to the email PDF. ZIP attachments keep the original ZIP and extract supported contents into a dedicated subfolder. Inline/CID resources stay embedded in the email rendering.

emailImport.zipModal.supportedInfo: PDF files are imported through the normal PDF workflow. Supported text, image and media files are copied into the ZIP subfolder automatically.
